newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania shilling steady on dollar, down on pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania shilling steady on dollar, down on pound.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling wss unchanged against the dollar but fell against sterling, the central Bank of Tanzania said.
Against the dollar, the shilling remained unchanged from Friday, exchanging at a commercial mean rate of 623.7000.
Against the pound, the local currency exchanged at 1032.1643 compared to Friday's 1028.0151.
Dealers predict more demand for dollars soon arising from an expected growth in imports which had slowed prior to the June 19 budget on expectation of widespread tax and duty reforms.
